wish: someone should make an app that plays audio with easy rewind and speed control for transcribing
spec:
Opens an audio file from your device and plays it with big jump-back/forward buttons, speed from 0.5x to 2x, and an automatic step back on resume.
Type the transcript in the box below; Esc plays/pauses and Alt+J/L/T jump or insert a [m:ss] timestamp; notes, speed and position are remembered.
It does not transcribe for you, upload anything, or stream audio from a URL.
notes: Audio is read as a data: URL because the CSP allows only data: media; very large files use more memory.
